visual_elements.description: Scatter plot with x-axis labeled 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and y-axis labeled 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. Light gray gridlines at major ticks. Four main clusters: black dots centered around x=12, y=20; magenta dots centered around x=18, y=20; green ring-shaped cluster centered around x=15, y=10 with a cyan/light blue hole at its center; blue elongated cluster centered around x=35, y=17. Red dots are scattered as outliers across the right side and surrounding areas, roughly x=28-48, y=8-28. One thin gray arrow points from upper-left toward the blue cluster.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font for axis numbers; slide number appears in bold black text inside yellow oval
recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank PowerPoint slide with light gray background (#F0F0F0).
2. Insert a white rectangle with a thin dark border centered on the slide to serve as the chart frame.
3. Add a scatter plot inside the frame with x-axis from 0 to 50 and y-axis from 0 to 30; show light gray gridlines.
4. Add axis tick labels: x: 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50; y: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30.
5. Plot black dots clustered around x=12, y=20.
6. Plot magenta dots clustered around x=18, y=20.
7. Plot green dots in a ring/donut shape centered around x=15, y=10.
8. Plot a cyan/light blue filled circle inside the green ring at its center.
9. Plot blue dots in an elongated cluster around x=35, y=17.
